title: Truck acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the truck's deceleration magnitude using kinematic equations with given stopping distance.

title: Initial separation distance
description: Essential: Correctly computes the distance between vehicles when taxi braking begins, accounting for both motions during reaction period.

title: Taxi braking acceleration
description: Essential: Determines taxi's deceleration such that it just reaches the truck as both stop, using relative motion analysis.

title: Truck motion during reaction
description: Important: Correctly calculates truck's displacement and velocity during taxi's reaction time before braking.

title: Taxi motion during reaction
description: Important: Correctly calculates taxi's displacement during looking and reaction phases before braking.

title: Relative motion setup
description: Important: Establishes correct kinematic equations for both vehicles' positions relative to time.

title: Time coordination
description: Important: Properly synchronizes time events: truck malfunction start, taxi reaction end, and both vehicles stopping.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for deceleration in kinematic equations (should be negative for slowing down).

title: Ignoring reaction time
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for the 0.5-second reaction delay between noticing danger and applying brakes.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations and presents final answers with proper units.
